# Roadmap — Langman 14e (E)

*(Purpose: step-by-step order to cover every core and exam-high concept: waves → seasons → episodes. Updated: 17 Nov 2026 · Bio · Build · K1 concept map. Rebuilt after every use gate.)*

**How it is ordered:** prerequisites first (topological order), then by unlock count (concepts that open the most later ones go first). Source: `curriculum/concept-map.md` / `content/E/map.json`. Generated by `tools/map/roadmap.py`; edit seasons there, not here.

**Episode ids** below are *provisional slots* (S2E03…) — an id becomes permanent only when its row is added to `curriculum/episodes-catalog.md` (A2). S1E01 is already fixed. ★ = core tag (×2); others are support (×1). Every season ends with a recap / connect-the-dots episode (D7). Clinical (Tier C) concepts become Mystery cold opens inside the episode that teaches the normal process.

**Coverage target:** 222 concepts (core 93 + exam-high 129).


## Wave 0 · Orientation (Part 0) — cards only

Cards E00.01.01–06 (C1, first batch). No episode; every episode links back to them. **Work:** C1 Part 0. **Owner check:** T3 (cards on phone).
